item.title: Hope Channel South Philippines is set to Sprint to 2026 with Renewed Mission and Commitment
item.description: Hope Channel South Philippines has officially begun its sprint to 2026, marking a renewed season of purpose and dedication for the faith-based media ministry. Anchored in its enduring slogan, “Sharing Love, Changing Lives,” the network continues its mission of delivering uplifting programs, creating meaningful online content, offering healing to broken spirits, and promoting a positive, hope-filled perspective to its audiences.

item.title: REACH 2026 Seminar: A Simple Call to Join the Mission
item.description: The REACH 2026 Seminar and Orientation finished strong, leaving a clear message: everyone has a role in the mission. Organized by NDR/IEL with the Sabbath School and Personal Ministries, Youth Ministries, and Elders, the one-day event showed that reaching every neighbor and every community starts with one person saying yes. This year’s gathering marked a milestone in North Central Mindanao, with 1,050 participants attending for the first time at the REACH 2025 Orientation and Seminar.

item.title: Mission Reach: Care Group Empowerment Seminar Calls Leaders to Intentional Discipleship
item.description: About 1,300 church leaders and Care Group leaders from three provinces gathered for the Mission Reach: Care Group Empowerment Seminar, a joint initiative of the Southwestern Philippine Union Conference and the Northeastern Mindanao Mission. The event served both as an orientation to the Southern Asia-Pacific Division’s quinquennial theme “Mission Reach” and as an empowerment seminar designed to equip church leaders to strengthen and multiply Care Groups as centers of discipleship and mission.

item.title: SwPUC Helps 250 Families Affected by Typhoon Basyang
item.description: The Southwestern Philippine Union Conference (SwPUC) provided relief assistance to 250 families hit hard by Typhoon Basyang, which struck Iligan City on February 5–6, 2026. The relief effort took place on March 3, 2026. Each family received grocery items, including 10 kilograms of jasmine rice and a dozen eggs.
